title.zh: 同样从云中诞生，结局却会分叉

context.zh: 选质量路径 · 拖动阶段 · 看外层与行星
context.en: CHOOSE A MASS PATH · MOVE THROUGH PHASES

progress.zh: 演化阶段 · 间隔不代表等长时间
progress.en: Evolution phase · spacing is not elapsed time

playbackNote.zh: 全程约 84 秒，最后 22 秒观察遗骸。阶段时长、晚期年代及冷却颜色均未作物理标定；可暂停、拖回或倒放。
playbackNote.en: About 84 seconds, including 22 seconds with the remnant. Phase durations, late epochs and cooling colors are not physically calibrated. Pause, scrub or reverse to compare.

afterAge.zh: 此年龄之后 · 后续时长未标定
afterAge.en: After this age · later span uncalibrated

cloudExtent.en: Cloud has no single surface radius

blackHoleExtent.zh: 视界尺寸未在本模型求出
blackHoleExtent.en: Horizon size not solved by this model

fusionMayOverlap.zh: 可能已开始，与吸积重叠

cloud.zh: 冷分子云 · 气体为主，含少量尘埃
cloud.en: Cold molecular cloud · mostly gas, some dust

accreting.zh: 稠密云核收缩 · 气体落入盘和原恒星
accreting.en: Dense core collapses · gas feeds disk and protostar

diskClears.zh: 吸积减弱 · 周围盘逐渐消散

magnified.zh: 辨认镜头 · 大小随半径变化

formationDetail.zh: 成星局部镜头 · 不按大小量尺
formationDetail.en: Formation close-up · not a size ruler

formationScale.zh: 冷云局部 · 不按行星轨道比例
formationScale.en: Cloud region · not on planetary-orbit scale

formerEnvelope.zh: 虚线：先前膨胀的外包层

neutronDiameter.zh: 中子星约 24 km 直径 · 遗骸符号已放大
neutronDiameter.en: Neutron star ~24 km across · marker enlarged

blackHoleNoDisk.zh: 黑洞位置符号 · 不预设吸积盘

solarSystem.zh: 太阳系轨道 · 半径共用同一比例
solarSystem.en: Solar System orbits · shared radius scale

earth.zh: 地球 · 命运有模型差异

scale.zh: 成星阶段的云、盘、喷流和中心亮斑是保持同一位置的过程示意，不按行星轨道尺量；喷流不代表所有恒星都一样。成星后左图恒星半径与行星轨道共用线性比例，右图非线性放大。巨星仍近似圆形；阶段曲线和年龄为教学近似。
scale.en: During formation the cloud, disk, outflow and central glow illustrate one evolving location and are not on the planetary-orbit ruler; not every star has the same outflow. After formation the left star radius and planetary orbits share a linear scale; the right view is enlarged nonlinearly. The giant remains nearly round. Stage curves and ages are teaching approximations.

scaleMassive.zh: 成星阶段的云、盘、喷流和中心亮斑是同一位置的过程示意；大质量恒星可能在继续吸积时就开始聚变。成熟恒星的左图轮廓与 900 个太阳半径标尺共用线性比例，遗骸阶段虚线保留原外包层；右图非线性放大。无供气条件时不画黑洞吸积盘。阶段是教学插值，不是流体或核心坍缩求解。
scaleMassive.en: The formation cloud, disk, outflow and central glow illustrate one location; massive stars can begin fusion while still accreting. Mature-star outlines on the left share a linear scale with the 900-solar-radius ruler, and the dashed remnant-stage outline keeps the former envelope. The right view enlarges nonlinearly. No black-hole accretion disk is assumed without gas supply. Stages interpolate for teaching, not fluid dynamics or core collapse.

spaceScale.zh: 拖动转动、滚轮或双指缩放；方向键也可转动。镜头近看恒星、拉远显示云壳，物质坐标与进度不变。大小用于辨认，无共用长度尺；阶段间隔不是等长时间。白矮星靠余热发光，中子星不一定观测成脉冲星。
spaceScale.en: Drag or use arrow keys to rotate; wheel or pinch to zoom. The camera moves closer to stars and wider for clouds and shells; matter coordinates and progress stay unchanged. Sizes are for recognition without one ruler; phases are not equal time intervals. White dwarfs shine from stored heat; not every neutron star is observed as a pulsar.

scaleLow.zh: 低质量分支最后三站是远未来理论示意，尚无同质量孤立恒星自然耗尽氢的观测；不画红巨星或爆炸壳。左侧 1 R☉ 尺只量成熟星轮廓，右侧单独放大。
scaleLow.en: The last three low-mass stops are theoretical distant-future illustrations, not observed isolated-star fuel exhaustion. No red giant or explosion shell is shown. The left 1 R☉ ruler measures mature-star outlines; the right is separately enlarged.

source3d.zh: 3D 教学形态 · 非观测重建
source3d.en: 3D teaching geometry · not an observed reconstruction

name.zh: 太阳型 · 约 1 个太阳质量

summary.zh: 太阳型代表分支：核心氢耗尽、红巨星、核心氦燃烧、再次膨胀、失去包层，最后成为白矮星。真实太阳的失重和星云亮度依模型而异；它不会在这条路径上成为黑洞。
summary.en: A representative Sun-like path: core hydrogen depletion, red giant, core helium burning, another giant phase, envelope loss and a white dwarf. Solar mass loss and nebular brightness depend on the model; this path does not make the Sun a black hole.

body.zh: 冷分子云以气体为主，只有少量尘埃。局部稠密云核受引力收缩，中心开始变亮；此时亮光来自收缩与吸积，尚不是稳定的核心氢聚变。
body.en: A cold molecular cloud is mostly gas with a little dust. A denser core collapses under gravity and its center begins to glow. Contraction and accretion power this early light, before sustained core hydrogen fusion.

body.zh: 物质向中心落下，旋转使部分气体形成扁平的吸积盘；有些形成中的恒星还沿轴向抛出物质。盘逐渐变薄，原恒星继续升温。喷流和盘是过程示意，不是流体计算。
body.en: Infall feeds the center while rotation flattens some gas into an accretion disk. Some forming stars also expel material along the axis. The disk thins as the protostar heats. Disk and outflow are process illustrations, not fluid calculations.

body.zh: 核心达到持续氢聚变的条件，氢变成氦并释放能量；原恒星成为主序星。图中从主序早期开始，太阳如今约 46 亿岁，仍处于这一漫长阶段。
body.en: Once the core sustains hydrogen fusion, hydrogen becomes helium and releases energy; the protostar joins the main sequence. The scene begins early in that phase. The Sun, now about 4.6 billion years old, is still in it.

body.zh: 核心氢供应减少，中心收缩变热，周围氢壳层开始更显著地供能。外层将响应内部变化，而不是突然换成另一颗星。
body.en: As core hydrogen runs low, the center contracts and heats while a surrounding hydrogen-burning shell becomes important. The envelope responds; this is still the same star.

body.zh: 红巨星顶端的代表半径为太阳的 180 倍，跨过水星、金星轨道。继续播放可见核心氦燃烧时包层收拢、后期壳层燃烧时再次膨胀。地球命运还涉及太阳失重、轨道响应和潮汐，不能只看静态圆圈；这些半径与阶段时长是教学近似。
body.en: The illustrative red-giant tip reaches 180 solar radii, crossing Mercury and Venus. Continue to see contraction during core helium burning and a later expansion during shell burning. Earth’s fate also involves mass loss, orbital response and tides; static circles cannot decide it. Radii and phase durations are teaching approximations.

body.zh: 恒星风先把外包层送入太空，逐渐显露的中央热星随后以紫外光电离部分气体。这是太阳型代表案例，不保证真实太阳形成同样明亮、规则的行星状星云；也不是超新星。此后阶段共用近似年代，实际经过时长未标定。
body.en: Winds carry the envelope outward; ultraviolet light from the emerging hot central star then ionizes some gas. This Sun-like example does not guarantee that the real Sun will make an equally bright, regular planetary nebula, and it is not a supernova. Later stages share a rounded epoch without calibrated elapsed durations.

body.zh: 留下大致地球大小的致密核心，不再靠稳定核心聚变供能，而是靠储存的热量发光并缓慢冷却。继续播放，平滑的小圆盘由蓝白转为较暖的白色，余辉减弱，周围抛出物逐渐淡去；结尾仍是发光的白矮星。屏幕颜色、亮度和冷却时长都是教学示意，不是计算得到的温度或年龄。
body.en: An approximately Earth-sized dense core remains. Stable core fusion has ended; stored heat makes it shine while it slowly cools. Continue playing: the smooth small disk shifts from blue-white toward warmer white, its glow weakens and surrounding ejecta fade. The endpoint is still a luminous white dwarf. Colors, brightness and cooling duration illustrate the process rather than computed temperatures or ages.

name.zh: 大质量 · 约 15 个太阳质量

summary.zh: 高质量恒星更快消耗燃料；这里选择一次留下中子星的核心坍缩案例。质量不能单独精确决定每一颗星的终点。
summary.en: A high-mass star uses fuel faster. This example chooses a core-collapse outcome leaving a neutron star. Initial mass alone does not precisely predict every star’s endpoint.

body.zh: 冷云中一处稠密区域继续吸积大量气体，也可能同时形成别的恒星。云的范围是示意；它不是一颗边界清楚的大恒星。
body.en: A dense region of a cold cloud accretes much more gas, and other stars may form nearby. The cloud extent is illustrative, not the surface of one giant star.

body.zh: 落入的气体在旋转盘中向内输送，部分物质可能沿轴向流出。大质量原恒星可能尚在吸积时就开始核心聚变，因此盘消散与聚变开始并非突然切换的两帧。
body.en: Infalling gas moves inward through a rotating disk while some may flow outward along the axis. A massive protostar may begin core fusion while still accreting, so disk dispersal and fusion are not two abruptly separate frames.

body.zh: 更大的质量使核心须更快地产生能量来支撑外层，因此寿命通常只有数百万到数千万年，远短于太阳。
body.en: Greater mass requires the core to generate energy faster to support the envelope, so the lifetime is often millions to tens of millions of years, far shorter than the Sun's.

body.zh: 核心氢耗尽后，收缩和新的聚变阶段继续；不同燃料逐步接力，越往后持续越短。这里不把所有大质量恒星画成完全相同的内部洋葱层。
body.en: After core hydrogen runs out, contraction and later fusion stages follow. Successive fuels last less time. The drawing does not prescribe identical onion-like layers for all massive stars.

body.zh: 外层可能扩张到数百个太阳半径。它的大小不表示核心也同样巨大；当前镜头展示外表面，不能从中量出内部核心。
body.en: The envelope may expand to hundreds of solar radii. The core is not equally huge; this view shows the exterior and cannot measure the internal core.

body.zh: 后期铁核无法再靠聚变获得净能量，失去支撑后快速坍缩。成功爆发的冲击波向外扫过并抛出外层；外壳扩大，中心却压缩成遗骸。过程与太阳缓慢抛层不同，这里不求解中微子输能或爆发速度。
body.en: A late iron core cannot gain net energy from further fusion and collapses when support fails. In a successful explosion, an outward shock ejects the envelope: the shell expands while the center becomes compact. This differs from the Sun’s gradual envelope loss. Neutrino transport and blast speed are not solved here.

body.zh: 这个案例留下约 24 千米直径的中子星；外侧发光的物质壳是超新星遗迹，和中心遗骸是两个不同部分。抛出物逐渐淡去，中心余热也会减少；图中的可见光颜色、亮度变化与放大圆盘只是辨认示意，实际冷却常用 X 射线观测约束。只有适合的发射束扫过地球时，一些旋转中子星才被观测为脉冲星；不能给每个中子星都套上可见灯塔。
body.en: This example leaves a neutron star about 24 km across. The surrounding shell is the supernova remnant, distinct from the compact central object. Ejecta fade and stored heat decreases. The enlarged disk and its visible color and brightness are recognition aids; actual cooling is often constrained by X-ray observations. Some rotating neutron stars are detected as pulsars when suitable beams sweep Earth; a visible lighthouse is not a property of every neutron star.

name.zh: 极大质量 · 约 30 个太阳质量

summary.zh: 这里选择形成恒星级黑洞的一个分支，不把 30 倍质量当成放之四海皆准的黑洞门槛。
summary.en: This example follows one stellar-black-hole outcome. Thirty solar masses is not a universal black-hole threshold.

body.zh: 稠密云核从以气体为主的分子云中收集物质；最终质量会改变之后的路径。中心初始亮度主要来自收缩和吸积。
body.en: A dense core gathers material from a mostly gaseous molecular cloud. Its final mass will affect the later path; early central light mainly comes from contraction and accretion.

body.zh: 气体经吸积盘继续流向原恒星，部分物质可能沿两极外流。大质量恒星的核心聚变与持续吸积可以重叠，画面让盘逐渐消散而不是瞬间换成另一颗星。
body.en: Gas continues through an accretion disk toward the protostar and some may flow out along the poles. Core fusion and continued accretion can overlap in massive stars; the disk fades rather than being replaced by another star at one instant.

body.zh: 巨大的核心压力要求很高的能量产率，因此代表性寿命只有几百万年。它并非太阳一路长大后的下一站。
body.en: Enormous core pressure requires a high energy output, giving a representative lifetime of only a few million years. It is not the Sun's next stage.

body.zh: 轻元素燃料逐步耗尽；质量损失、金属丰度和相伴恒星都会影响结局。
body.en: Successive light-element fuels run low. Mass loss, composition and companions can alter the outcome.

body.zh: 这里画一个有膨胀包层的示例。极大质量恒星并非都必经同一种红超巨星形态。
body.en: This example has an expanded envelope. Very massive stars do not all pass through the same red-supergiant form.

body.zh: 核心坍缩；外层抛射与回落的细节因恒星而异。画面不预言具体一颗星的爆发亮度或遗骸质量。 画面选择能抛出物质的爆发与回落案例；形成黑洞并不保证一定有明亮超新星。
body.en: The core collapses. Ejection and fallback differ among stars. The scene predicts neither a particular explosion brightness nor a remnant mass. The scene selects an explosion/fallback case with ejecta; black-hole formation does not guarantee a bright supernova.

body.zh: 这个分支留下恒星级黑洞。左侧虚线保留坍缩前的外包层；黑色记号只是位置符号，不能拿来量事件视界。吸积盘不是黑洞自带的：有些坍缩回落物能很快形成盘，另一些孤立遗骸则没有明亮的盘；本画面不预设供气。
body.en: This branch leaves a stellar black hole. The dashed outline retains the pre-collapse envelope; the dark mark locates the remnant but does not measure its horizon. An accretion disk is not intrinsic to a black hole: fallback can form one promptly in some collapses, while other isolated remnants lack a bright disk. This scene assumes no particular gas supply.

name.zh: 低质量 · 约 0.2 个太阳质量

summary.zh: 红矮星可持续聚变数万亿年。后三站是远未来理论示意；宇宙还不够老，尚无这种孤立红矮星自然耗尽燃料的实测演化。不安排红巨星、超新星或明亮行星状星云。
summary.en: A red dwarf can fuse for trillions of years. The last three stops are a theoretical distant future: the Universe is too young for an isolated star of this mass to have exhausted its fuel. No red giant, supernova or bright planetary nebula is imposed.

name.en: Small core in a cold cloud

body.zh: 局部云核在引力下收缩，气体的压强、湍流和磁场会影响能否继续。最终只吸积较少物质的恒星，可能成为低质量红矮星。
body.en: A local cloud core contracts under gravity; pressure, turbulence and magnetic fields affect whether it continues. A star that ultimately accretes less material may become a low-mass red dwarf.

body.zh: 旋转的物质形成盘，收缩与吸积先供给光热。低质量原恒星抵达稳定核心氢聚变所需的时间通常比大质量恒星更长。
body.en: Rotating material forms a disk, while contraction and accretion first supply light and heat. A low-mass protostar generally takes longer than a massive one to reach sustained core hydrogen fusion.

body.zh: 约 0.2 个太阳质量的代表星，表面温度约 3200 K。大范围对流使新鲜氢能继续到达内侧；它虽有较少燃料，消耗却慢得多。
body.en: A representative 0.2-solar-mass star has a surface temperature near 3200 K. Extensive convection brings fresh hydrogen inward. It has less fuel but uses it far more slowly.

body.zh: 这一步已超出现今宇宙约 138 亿年的年龄。读数中的万亿年是模型量级，不能当成已经拍到的老红矮星，也不能把每个阶段等时播放理解为真实时长。
body.en: This stop exceeds the current Universe’s age of about 13.8 billion years. Trillions of years are a theoretical scale, not the measured age of an observed old red dwarf. Equal playback intervals do not mean equal durations.

body.zh: 低质量理论演化与太阳型分支不同：氢逐渐变少，恒星可变得更热，而不形成太阳式的巨大红巨星。这里的半径和时间只作远未来代表锚点。
body.en: The theoretical low-mass evolution differs from the Sun’s: as hydrogen declines, the star may grow hotter without becoming a huge Sun-like red giant. Radii and times here are illustrative distant-future anchors.

body.zh: 燃料最终耗尽后，低质量遗留物趋向致密的冷却状态。此分支不产生一圈超新星冲击壳，也不把所有白矮星前身都画成同样的行星状星云。
body.en: After the fuel is eventually exhausted, the low-mass remnant approaches a compact cooling state. This branch makes no supernova shock shell and does not give every white-dwarf progenitor the same planetary nebula.

body.zh: 模型预期最终留下以氦为主的白矮星，靠储存的热量缓慢冷却。继续播放可见余辉减弱，结尾仍保留发光的小圆盘；颜色和时长没有标定为温度与年龄。孤立低质量红矮星自然演化至此尚未发生于当前宇宙；双星中的低质量白矮星可有不同形成途径。
body.en: Models predict a helium-rich white dwarf that cools through stored heat. Continue playing to see its glow weaken while the endpoint retains a luminous small disk; color and duration are not calibrated temperatures or ages. Natural isolated red-dwarf evolution to this state has not occurred within the present Universe’s age; low-mass white dwarfs in binaries can have other formation routes.

name.zh: 核心氦燃烧：巨星暂时收拢

body.zh: 氦核点燃后，恒星重新调整结构，外包层会比红巨星顶端更紧凑，但仍远大于主序太阳。氦闪发生在内部，不是把外层炸开的超新星；这里不展示内部的瞬时过程。
body.en: After helium ignites in the core, the star readjusts and its envelope becomes more compact than at the red-giant tip, while remaining much larger than the main-sequence Sun. The helium flash is internal, not a supernova that blasts off the envelope; its rapid interior physics is not animated.

name.zh: 再次膨胀：氢、氦壳层供能
name.en: Giant again: hydrogen and helium shells

body.zh: 核心氦耗尽后，碳氧核心外的氢、氦壳层继续供能，外包层再次膨胀，进入渐近巨星支。它不是倒放成原来的红巨星，也不是重新得到核心氢；两次膨胀之间的大小与时长是教学近似。
body.en: After core helium is depleted, hydrogen and helium shells around the carbon–oxygen core supply energy and the envelope expands again onto the asymptotic giant branch. This is a later giant phase, not a rewind or renewed core hydrogen. The intervening sizes and durations are teaching approximations.

name.zh: 恒星风逐渐带走外包层
name.en: Stellar winds carry the envelope away

body.zh: 松散的气体先向外流失，留下的中央恒星逐渐收缩。观察同一批外层物质持续向外，它不会跟着中心一起缩回去；尚未充分电离的气体也不会立刻变成明亮的彩色壳。
body.en: Loose gas flows outward while the remaining central star contracts. Follow the same outer material moving away: it does not shrink back with the center. Gas that is not yet strongly ionized does not instantly become a bright colored shell.

name.zh: 中央热星显露，周围气体渐亮
name.en: Hot center emerges; surrounding gas brightens

body.zh: 包层变薄后，中央恒星继续收缩升温，增强的紫外光逐渐电离先前流出的气体。物质外流和气体发光是两个重叠的过程。晚期各段共用近似年代，不把屏幕停留时间或年龄读数当作星云寿命。
body.en: As the envelope thins, the central star contracts and heats. Increasing ultraviolet radiation ionizes gas that has already flowed out. Matter leaving and gas lighting up are overlapping processes. Late phases share a rounded epoch; screen time and the age readout do not measure a nebula lifetime.

name.zh: 发光的气体包围致密核心
name.en: Glowing gas surrounds the compact core

body.zh: 这里选择能照亮周围气体的太阳型代表案例：中央小热星与向外扩散的行星状星云是两个部分。真实太阳是否形成明亮的行星状星云仍依赖失重与升温模型，形态也不保证规则；它不是超新星。随后观察同一个白矮星慢慢冷却。
body.en: This Sun-like example lights up its surrounding gas: the small hot central star and the expanding planetary nebula are distinct. Whether the real Sun produces a bright planetary nebula depends on mass-loss and heating models, and its shape need not be regular. It is not a supernova. Next, follow the same white dwarf as it cools.
